name: Legacy testimonial card
purpose: Closes a legacy content page with one customer's endorsement of the content service, framed by their logo.
description: A hairline-bordered card (legacy theme border colour) over a decorative full-bleed background image at 85% opacity, holding a 2-column grid: customer logo on the left, and on the right a body-size quote with a client row below (3.5rem round photo, semibold name, grey role). Padding 3.5rem/2.5rem, tightening per breakpoint; at <=767 it becomes one column and the client photo stacks above the name. Theme switches the legacy colour set (yellow on /content/service, green on /content/custom-content); the logo box is tall (5rem, 3rem at >=1440) or wide (2.5rem).
